tasks.description: Deterministic RED tests capture worker model/extension/enablement, bounded roles, routing, self-contained handoffs, and project approval gates without modifying production prompts or agent definitions.

Tests require branch/worktree/commit/integration/dependency/new-file and active-artifact mutations to stop for explicit approval.

tasks.title: Configure bounded GLM Fabric workers
tasks.description: build and general are spawnable GLM 5.2 implementation workers with Fabric access, explicit no-nesting behavior, strict task scope, and approval-aware stop conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Both workers pin makora/zai-org/GLM-5.2-NVFP4 through authoritative frontmatter and do not accept caller model/thinking overrides.
Both workers load the proven extension surface required for fabric_exec.
build is enabled and rewritten as a bounded implementation worker rather than a nested orchestrator.
general remains optimized for surgical tasks and review fixes.
Both workers stop on undeclared files, architecture changes, scope growth, lifecycle mutation, or operations lacking required approval.
Pre-existing workspace edits in both files are re-read and preserved; overlapping concurrent changes cause a stop rather than silent replacement.

tasks.title: Route /ship through bounded GLM workers
tasks.description: The canonical shipping and delegation surfaces select build or general by bounded task criteria, provide complete Fabric worker envelopes, retain parent ownership, and stop at unapproved operations.
acceptance_criteria: The parent routes normally one-to-three-file surgical tasks and review fixes to general, and larger bounded implementation tasks to build.
Every child implementation and fix uses Pi Agent for orchestration and fabric_exec for code-mode changes.
Every child receives a self-contained task envelope with identity/attempt, files/neighborhood, non-goals, dependencies, acceptance criteria, verification, stop conditions, and approval restrictions.
Children cannot schedule graph nodes, mutate .active or lifecycle state, integrate work, or spawn nested agents.
The parent inspects actual changes, reruns verification, owns review and graph transitions, and recomputes the frontier after accepted transitions.
Branch/worktree creation, commits, merges/integration, pushes/deployments, dependencies, new files, and active-artifact mutations are explicit approval checkpoints rather than automatic actions.
Concurrent waves remain limited to at most three disjoint tasks and use isolated worktrees only after separate approval.
verification: node --experimental-strip-types --test --test-name-pattern="ship routes GLM Fabric workers with self-contained contracts|ship honors project approval gates|ship executes a validated dynamic frontier|subagent coordination remains Pi-native and parent-verified" .pi/tests/skill-system.test.ts
